zh.legendTitleBody: 说明改变什么，例如「权限」。
zh.legendDescBody: 解释影响范围，例如「选择新会话的默认权限模式」。
zh.legendControlBody: 展示当前值或可执行动作。
zh.legendDividerBody: 分隔线属于相邻行之间的布局，不写成行内文字或状态标签。
zh.legendNote: 设置行是结构建议；文字与控件摘自 DSH 干净实景。

en.legendHeading: How to read a settings row
en.legendTitleBody: says what changes, for example Permissions.
en.legendDescBody: explains the scope of the effect, for example the default permission mode for new conversations.
en.legendControlBody: shows the current value or the action you can run.
en.legendDividerBody: The divider belongs to the layout between neighbouring rows; it is not written as in-row text or a state label.
en.legendNote: The settings row is a structural proposal; the text and controls are taken from a clean DSH capture.
